chlorhexidine-antibacterial-body-wash.text: Users apply antibacterial washes such as chlorhexidine to calm body folliculitis, aiming for smoother, clearer skin on the back, chest and shoulders. It is studied in hospitals for bacterial decolonization; its use for folliculitis bumps rests on anecdote.

antibiotics-doxycycline-for-back-acne.text: Doxycycline is prescribed for moderate to severe acne, and people with inflamed back and body acne use it to clear lesions and reduce marks. Acne is a studied use of the drug, with guidelines favouring short courses alongside non-antibiotic treatments.

sunless-tan-body-makeup-to-hide-marks.text: Self-tanner and body makeup visibly blend stretch marks and scars into surrounding skin for the day or week. The color change is immediate and measurable, and users apply it before beach days, photos or shirtless occasions.

dermablend-tattoo-cover.text: Camouflage makeup such as Dermablend is used to conceal tattoos, scars, vitiligo patches and bruises with heavier coverage than foundation. The concealing effect is visible as soon as it is applied and lasts until it is washed off.

scar-tattooing-micropigmentation.text: Micropigmentation deposits skin-toned pigment into scars or pale patches so they blend with surrounding skin, and it is used after surgery and for vitiligo. The color match is visible once healed; published outcome data are limited to clinical documentation.

stretch-mark-surgery-tummy-tuck.text: Abdominoplasty removes excess abdominal skin and tightens the muscle, so stretch marks on the removed skin go with it and the midsection looks flatter. People seek it after pregnancy or major weight loss, and the change is visible after healing.

slow-bulking-slow-growth-to-avoid-stretc.text: Lifters gain size gradually in the belief that it lowers the chance of stretch marks on shoulders, arms and chest while building a bigger physique. Rapid growth is a recognised risk factor for striae, but no trial has tested slow bulking itself.

cellulite-lasers-cellfina.text: Cellfina and laser devices are used to smooth cellulite dimples on the thighs and buttocks. Cellfina has 3-year follow-up data for dimple-type cellulite, while evidence for lasers is thinner.

body-shaving-hair-removal-for-skin-textu.text: Men shave the chest, arms, legs or back to look smoother and to show muscle definition, especially for physique photos and competitions. The smoother look is visible straight away and is treated in appearance communities as a style choice.

brazilian-tan-spray-tan-to-even-skin.text: Spray tans apply a DHA solution to evens out skin tone and give a bronzed look that lasts about a week. The color is visible within hours and is used before events, shoots and competitions.

estrogen-hormone-skin-theories-dht-acne.text: Forum posters link DHT, steroids and estrogen to acne and discuss anti-androgen or estrogen approaches to clearer skin. Dermatology links androgens to sebum and acne, but the looksmaxxing-specific protocols lack dedicated studies.

steroid-back-acne-management.text: Users of anabolic steroids or testosterone discuss back and shoulder acne as a side effect and look for ways to keep the skin clear while building physique. Acne is a recognised effect of these drugs; management advice is mostly general acne information.

sliding-genioplasty.text: Sliding genioplasty repositions the chin bone forward, back or sideways to reshape the chin and balance the profile. The result is visible after healing, and the evidence is mostly case series with few comparative trials.

gonial-angle-reduction-v-line-surgery.text: V-line surgery removes bone at the jaw angle to narrow the lower face into a tapered outline, often alongside chin reshaping. It is established in East Asian aesthetic surgery, with evidence mostly from surgeon case series.

custom-peek-medpor-jaw-implants.text: Patient-specific Medpor or PEEK implants add width or length to the jaw angle and ramus for a more defined lower face. The change is visible once swelling settles; published outcome data for purely cosmetic use is limited.

ramus-vertical-ramus-augmentation.text: Ramus augmentation, usually with a custom implant, adds height to the vertical part of the jaw for a longer, squarer jawline. The shape change is visible after healing, and very little cosmetic outcome data has been published.

chain: Chin and jaw sit further forward
mandibular-advancement-surgery-bsso.text: BSSO moves the lower jaw forward and is used by looksmaxxers to improve a recessed lower third and side profile. It is a well-studied orthognathic operation for bite and function, usually combined with orthodontics.

facetite-renuvion.text: FaceTite and Renuvion are used to tighten loose skin and sharpen the jawline and neck without a facelift. Evidence is mostly case series, and the FDA has warned about off-label use.

chain: Tighter skin on jaw and neck
morpheus8-rf-microneedling.text: Morpheus8 is promoted for tightening skin and remodeling fat along the jawline and neck. Its evidence comes mainly from case series and reviews.

hard-food-diet-tough-foods.text: Followers chew raw carrots, tough meats and similar foods in the belief that it improves jaw and facial development. No human trial has shown that it changes jaw shape.

jaw-chewing-with-falim-gum-8-hours.text: Users chew Falim gum for hours a day to enlarge the masseter and widen the lower face. Muscle growth from chewing is plausible; the aesthetic results of such long sessions are anecdotal, and forum posters report jaw pain.

chin-strap-while-sleeping.text: Users wear chin straps during sleep to encourage nasal breathing and a closed-mouth resting posture, often alongside mewing or mouth taping. The link to facial reshaping is anecdotal and untested.

myofunctional-therapy.text: Myofunctional therapy is used clinically for sleep apnea and tongue dysfunction, and looksmaxxing communities discuss it for tongue posture and jaw development. The facial-appearance use is untested.

jaw-contouring-makeup-contour-highlight.text: Contour and highlight makeup makes the jawline look more defined for photos, video and events. The effect is visible as soon as it is blended and lasts until removed.

neck-tension-platysma-flex.text: Posers flex the platysma to make the jaw-neck transition look more defined in photos and mirror checks. The effect is visible while the muscle is tensed; it is a posing habit rather than something studied.

lower-face-rejuvenation-filler-jowl-fill.text: Filler along the pre-jowl and marionette areas is used to smooth the lower face and restore the line of the jaw. The result is visible right after injection; jowl-specific trial data is thin.

jaw-expansion-via-mse-sarpe.text: SARPE and MSE widen the upper jaw in adults and are discussed in forums for facial width, cheek fullness and bite, often alongside braces or jaw surgery. They are established orthodontic procedures with documented complications.

braces-orthodontics-for-jaw-shape.text: Braces are used to align teeth and bite, and in looksmaxxing circles to improve profile, especially combined with jaw surgery. Orthodontics is established dental treatment that can change the profile somewhat.

prf-prp-face-contouring.text: PRF and PRP made from a patient's own blood are used in aesthetic clinics to add facial volume and improve skin quality. They are used in clinics for skin, but true contouring has not been trialled.

tongue-pressing-against-roof-tongue-push.text: Tongue push-ups are a forceful mewing variant in which people press the tongue against the roof of the mouth, aiming to reshape the jaws and face. The facial-change claim has no studies behind it.
